**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge (a `feat`: it merges at the next cut).** I found no blockers.

This is a safety-tier review. The PR changes the import data flow in `kernel` and `geometry`. It does not change a facet, a toolpath, a post or the project file.

## What looks good

- The face order is correct. `machining_mesh` meshes `solid.record`, the decoded record in record order (`crates/kernel/src/machining_mesh.rs:224-230`). `names::read` checks the count against `body.record.faces.len()`. Thus `tri_face[i]` and `names[f]` index the same record.
- `push_facets` keeps the triangle order, and `parse` keeps a record only when `tri_face.len()` is the facet count and the ranges tile the facets.
- The app guard is good. `source_faces::of` gives the record only at the same revision and facet count. Thus a facet landing that does not state the names (a repair, a rebuild, a later command) cannot keep stale names.
- Names never refuse an import (D2). A misfit gives one note. All new source code has no `unwrap`, `expect`, `panic!` or unchecked cast.
- The component is in `schema.rs`. The app helper reads and writes the world, so it is in the correct crate. The plain data type is in `geometry`. There is no new crate dependency.
- All callers of `Graded` and of `UpdateModel ... .with_source(...)` also pass the names: the window, the script and MCP import, and the fixture re-import.
- Each new module and test file has a provenance line. Each test file is in the lowest crate that it imports.
- The body ends with `Fixes #4212` and has a `Changelog:` line. It is not a process change.

## Mutations (each reverted after the run)

1. `names::read` returns the list shifted by one (`out.rotate_left(1)`). Red: `names::format_10_names_are_read_one_for_each_record_face`, `names::every_triangle_of_a_named_face_lies_on_that_faces_plane`, `names::a_solidcraft_written_file_names_its_faces_in_record_order`.
2. `source_faces::of` does not compare the revision. Red: `source_faces::names_that_do_not_describe_the_facets_are_never_handed_out`.
